name: agent-control
description: Local agent control plane for declarative flows, native Codex subagent orchestration, supervision, and live inspection through MCP, CLI, and a native console.

interface.shortDescription: Declarative flows, native Codex subagents, CLI, and live console
interface.longDescription: A deterministic local control plane and native Codex console for running declarative flows, bridging root-owned Codex subagent v2 actions, supervising Codex and OpenCode workers, recording artifacts and transitions, polling only cheap external status, visualizing agent relationships, exposing compact local API/WebSocket state, and delivering durable event subscriptions with renewable waits and explicit acknowledgement.
defaultPrompt: Use $development-flow to clarify a software task and run development-flow-v1.
Use $flow-author to design or refine declarative Agent Control flow configs.
Use $flow-runner to discover, execute, resume, inspect, or debug an Agent Control flow.
